# Professor Xuefeng Zhu (祝雪峰)

> Official academic homepage of Professor Xuefeng Zhu (祝雪峰), Dalian University of Technology.

Professor Xuefeng Zhu is a professor whose research covers isogeometric analysis and industrial software, intelligent computational mechanics, AI-agent simulation methods, digital twins, quantum computing, and CAD/CAE integration. His work includes B++ splines, conforming embedded-domain isogeometric analysis, and the ADIGA industrial software platform.
